title: AI Enhancer
tagline: Real-time restoration, entirely on your phone
description: Real-time audio restoration for 44.1 and 48 kHz tracks, off by default. Full model runs on a supported neural chip. Other phones use Lite mode on the main processor. Audio stays on your phone.
overview: The AI Enhancer restores high-frequency detail on 44.1 and 48 kHz audio. It is off by default and runs on your phone. Supported phones run the full model on a neural chip, while others use Lite mode. The DSP rack turns off automatically while it runs.

benefits.title: Restores upper band detail
benefits.desc: Restores detail between 14 and 22 kHz inside the file's sample rate. It never invents ultrasonic content.

benefits.title: Runs on your phone
benefits.desc: Full model on a supported neural chip, or Lite mode on the processor. Works offline after download.

benefits.title: Checks hardware first
benefits.desc: The app tests performance before enabling the model. It turns off if the phone cannot keep up.

benefits.title: Honest signal badge
benefits.desc: The signal badge shows Enhanced while active. It stops saying Bit-perfect as soon as sound changes.

facts: One-time model download on first enable; works fully offline
Off by default, enabled with a single toggle in Settings
Works on 44.1 and 48 kHz audio only; other files play untouched
Full model on a supported neural chip, Lite mode on the processor
Switches the DSP rack off automatically while it runs
Audio stays on your phone while it runs

specs.label: Status
specs.value: Off by default, enabled in Settings

lede: The enhancer rebuilds the upper band, about 14 to 22 kHz, of 44.1 and 48 kHz files. It is off by default and runs on your phone.

beats.title: A plausible rebuild, not the original
beats.body: It rebuilds the upper band, about 14 to 22 kHz, at the file's own sample rate. It works on 44.1 and 48 kHz files only. It adds nothing above that.

beats.title: Only on your phone
beats.body: Audio stays on your phone. It needs no network while it plays. The model downloads once, when you first turn it on. Then it works offline.

beats.title: It turns off before it stutters
beats.body: It is off by default. A supported neural chip runs the full model. Other phones use Lite mode on the main processor. If the phone cannot keep up in real time, the enhancer turns itself off.

beats.title: The badge stops saying Bit-perfect
beats.body: As soon as the enhancer changes the sound, the badge shows Enhanced. It does not run on DSD, while casting, or with Karaoke on. While it runs, the sound processing rack is off.
beats.note: While the AI Enhancer is on, the sound processing rack is off.

cta.title: High-frequency harmonic restoration on your phone.
cta.body: Included in the same subscription as everything else. Off until you switch it on.
